metaDescription: Bracket Bear is a values-driven creative technology partner built on the art of hospitality. We help experience agencies remove what limits them so their magic can thrive.

hero.subtitle: We give exceptional service to the people who create experiences — helping agencies remove what limits them, so their magic can thrive.

intro.title: Intro Section
intro.content:
Bracket Bear is a values-driven creative technology partner built on the art of hospitality.
We believe experience agencies deserve the same care, curiosity, and service they offer their own clients.
Our work starts with a simple question — one that guides everything we do:
intro.magicWandQuestion:
"If you could wave a magic wand and fix one thing keeping your agency from reaching its potential, what would it be?"
Whatever that is, that's where we begin.

services.title: Augment Your Team
services.description: We embed with your team like an extension of it, bringing specialized creative or technical expertise that feels seamless, not supplemental.

services.title: Deliver the Project
services.description: We take the reins from prototype to installation so you can focus on creative leadership while we bring it to life.

services.title: Consult & Collaborate
services.description: We share years of experience building tools, systems, and installations to help you make confident, informed decisions.

values.title: We're hospitality minded
values.description: We extend the same thoughtfulness and attention to our partners that they give their audiences.

values.title: We're values first
values.description: If it doesn't align with our principles, we don't do it — every project should serve people, not just pixels.

values.title: We're scalable by design
values.description: We grow alongside our partners through modular, flexible collaboration.

values.title: We bring founder-level experience
values.description: From award-winning agencies like Downstream and Deeplocal.

contactCTA.text:
We build technology with a human touch.
Tell us what your magic wand would fix — and let's start there.
